site_name: 1 Library Court, 391 High Road, Tottenham, London, N17 6QN
description: The proposals are that the existing timber windows to the front and side elevations be removed and replaced with new high-quality double-glazed slimline timber vertical sliding sash and casement windows to best match existing.  The rear elevation existing timber windows are to be removed and replaced with new high-quality double-glazed uPVC casement windows. The proposals are that the existing French timber doors be removed and replaced with a new updated double-glazed timber French doors, to best match the existing.  The existing rear exit door will be removed and replaced with new high quality double-glazed uPVC door.
